objective: Compare strict complete literal and maximally bounded-wildcard translations of all nine schedule partitions after proximity removal.

source_window.cutoff_handling: Retain 2026 records for later screening against the exact diagnostic cutoff.

controls.database: exactly one allowed PQDT Global database label
controls.screenshots: automatic configured search-page and first results-page PNGs beside every JSON

translation.wildcard_atom: NOFT(token or ordered phrase using the smallest safe bounded [*n])
translation.wildcard_scope: Every declared variant family with one safe common source stem. Singleton, punctuation, and unsafe-stem alternatives remain literal.

compound_blocks.G_model: G_model_fixed OR G_mission_exact OR (G_mission AND M_B)
compound_blocks.G_structure: G_structure_fixed OR G_product_exact OR G_variation OR (G_product AND M_B)

acceptance_checks: Every event receives exact source query, scope, year, language, variant, and sort readback.
Every event completes two full record passes with the same total and ordered numeric document IDs.
Every event saves both mandatory sibling screenshots with matching JSON receipts.
Every wildcard partition contains every stable ID from its fresh adjacent literal partition.
Every wildcard-only record is inspected against the intended protocol concepts before adoption.
No proximity, pair expansion, result-driven split, type, access, or vocabulary restriction is introduced.
stop_rules: Stop on the first source, access, challenge, control, screenshot, cleanup, or output failure.
Retain a failed adapter JSON and any screenshots already captured.
Never replace an event JSON, marker, screenshot, assessment, or validation report.
